implemented: A pure UMD co-op camera contract owns solo framing, honest midpoint framing, named distance states, bounded camera pullback and symmetric outward movement constraints.
The shared view is together through 22m, begins soft outward damping after 26m, names regroup from 31m and holds further radial separation at 36m.
Inward movement remains unchanged and tangential input follows the hard boundary; neither player is teleported or granted camera priority.
The P2 HUD names current state and distance. A gold ground tether appears in the wide band and becomes coral in regroup; reduced motion retains it without pulse.
Solo retains the existing 22/28/26 perspective offset and exposes no co-op card or co-op diagnostic dataset.
The rule adds no timer, damage, currency, consumable, reward, drop, quest or progression consequence.

live.claim: The old camera degraded at large separation and the corrected camera presents explicit readable bands.
live.observed: Before the change, roughly 50m separation made both heroes very small through unbounded pullback and provided no regroup feedback. After the change, focused 8m, 27m and 34m states visibly read TOGETHER, SHARED VIEW WIDENING and REGROUP with no tether, a gold tether and a coral tether/HUD respectively.

live.claim: The shipping hard edge holds outward travel while immediately preserving inward control.
live.observed: After 320 outward ArrowRight presses, separation was 35.99m, outward scale was 0.001 and camera height was 34.48. Eight ArrowLeft presses reduced separation to 33.88m, a 2.11m decrease, with movement scale restored to 1.000.

live.claim: Solo presentation remains separate from the co-op covenant.
live.observed: The P2 card was hidden, P2 text was absent and no co-op camera state attribute was published while the solo hero remained at the staged meadow position.

limitations: Production Blender rigs, facial animation and authored attack clips remain unavailable; procedural geometry is still the visual substrate.
The rolling-frame capability was unavailable. Exact movement/boundary math is deterministic test and direct state evidence, not screenshot-timed inference.
Physical gamepad feel and long-session two-human camera comfort remain outside this bounded pass.
